about_the_game:
This is a pixel-style card game with over 30 hero cards for you to choose from. Each hero card has its own unique skill, including warriors, mages, supports, controllers, tanks, and various other types. The selection of different characters builds diverse battle formations, bringing you a unique experience!

When you challenge enemies with your favorite lineup, remember that there is also a powerful equipment system for you to choose from. With 7 basic equipment types, the rich synthesis upgrade system can derive over 50+ types of equipment. Rich equipment combined with variously positioned hero cards makes lineup construction more flexible!

Be cautious, the enemy is not just shrimp soldiers and crab generals! There is also a potion and scroll system to assist you in your journey! There are 8 potions and over 10 scrolls for you to use. The rational use of potions and scrolls will achieve unexpected effects!

3 game modes, 10+ scenes, 10 bosses, and 30+ enemies/formation for you to conquer! March on triumphantly, MY HERO!

  • Pixel style

  • Strategy card

  • Automatic Battle

short_description: This is a turn-based card game. Build a powerful team, reasonably arrange your cards according to the environment, and fully utilize the equipment, potions, and scrolls you have obtained. Keep fighting until you reach the deepest part of the enemy's territory!
